stage_2p5_todo.name: ladder_and_transport_tuning_on_1d_model
stage_2p5_todo.goal: Tune the minimal TLTM ladder and transport behavior on the 1d model before any fallback-enabled vs fallback-disabled comparison.

notes: Short scan completed on baseline + 3 candidate ladders.
Long check completed on baseline and 2 promising ladders.
Reference ladder frozen for stage-3 matched-control runs.

stage_boundary.stage_2_role: build and validate the minimal TLTM mechanism (slot model, adjacent swap, label tracking, round-trip bookkeeping, base logs)
stage_boundary.stage_2p5_role: tune ladder and transport using the stage-2 mechanism as-is

transport_success_criteria.note: Round trip is a strong diagnostic, but not a hard failure criterion for short runs.

todo.task: Freeze one reference local-update parameter set
details: Choose one global nstep
Choose one global trajectory length L
Choose one global step-size policy
Choose one global solver tolerance
Choose one global projection cap
Use exactly the same local-update settings for all replicas during stage 2.5

todo.task: Define the initial broken reference ladder
details: Record the current ladder that produced the severe low-flow bottleneck
Use it as the baseline for comparison against tuned ladders

todo.task: Construct a small ladder scan concentrated near the low-flow bottleneck
details: Insert additional flow-time points between the first disconnected pair
Keep the upper-flow part unchanged at first
Use only a few candidate ladders in the first pass

todo.task: Run short diagnostic jobs for each candidate ladder
details: Use the same cycle count for all candidate ladders in the first pass
Store pairwise swap acceptance for every adjacent pair
Store label slot trajectories
Store farthest slot reached by each label

todo.task: Identify whether the original bottleneck is removed
details: Check whether the previously zero-acceptance pair becomes nonzero
Check whether labels can cross that location
Reject ladders that remain effectively disconnected

todo.task: Select one or two promising ladders from the short scan
details: Prefer ladders with no near-zero adjacent acceptance
Prefer ladders where labels traverse more than one or two slots
Do not require full round trip yet if the run is short

todo.task: Run longer transport tests on the promising ladders
details: Increase cycle count only after a ladder passes the short diagnostic scan
Check whether some labels reach the hot end
Check whether round trips start to appear
Record round-trip times if observed

todo.task: Evaluate cold-slot measurement stability under the candidate ladders
details: Check whether cold-slot observables are numerically stable
Check whether swap introduces obvious pathologies
Treat transport and cold-slot measurement as separate diagnostics

todo.task: Decide whether global local-update tuning is needed
details: Only after ladder repair, decide whether the global nstep or global L should be adjusted
If needed, scan global nstep or global L symmetrically across all replicas
Do not introduce replica-specific parameters

todo.task: Lock one stage-2.5 reference ladder for stage 3
details: Choose one ladder that is transport-viable and stable on the 1d model
Freeze it before fallback-enabled vs fallback-disabled comparison
Use this frozen ladder in stage 3 matched-control runs

rationale: Removes the strongest low-flow bottleneck relative to baseline in long check.
Shows better low-flow adjacent acceptance than the denser low-end candidate tested.
Observed nonzero round trips in long-check diagnostics.

exit_criteria: A reference ladder is found with no zero-acceptance bottleneck in the low-flow region
Labels can cross the previously blocked region
Transport is visibly improved compared with the broken ladder
One ladder is frozen for use in stage 3
